topic: IP-as-Logo Agent Skill 2026: Simplified Rounded Neo-Skeuomorphic Logos

key_points: The canonical open-source Agent Skill (MIT) for generating extremely simple, cute, company-ready IP mascot logos
4767 stars, 239 forks, created 2026-08-18, actively maintained (last push 2026-08-22)
Follows the open Agent Skills format; works with Codex, Coze, Doubao, YouMind, Manus, Gemini Apps, Replit Agent
Requires a top-tier image model: GPT Image 2 preferred, or Seedance 5.0 Pro, Nano Banana Pro, Nano Banana 2
Core rules: one dominant silhouette from 4-7 large basic shapes, exactly three semantic colors (two IP base + one background), dominant lower-corner composition filling 85-95% of canvas
One-pass batch generation: three proposed directions, six independent candidates (A1/A2/B1/B2/C1/C2), no filtering or auto-retry
Never reveals logo/brand-mark/app-icon use in the generation prompt; describes only a square character image
Recognizable at 32x32; forbids sharp corners, thin antennae, needle-like tails; thick rounded weighty contours
Official free searchable library of ready-made IP-as-Logo images, backed by Cloudflare R2 and Supabase
Every logo free for commercial use; download without needing Codex/Doubao/Coze/Workbuddy
Companion site to the GitHub skill, showcases the output style

Context: agent skills are becoming a distribution channel for reusable AI workflows

angles: The 'IP-as-Logo' skill is a standout example of the 2026 agent-skills trend: a single SKILL.md document that encodes a complete brand-design methodology
Neo-skeuomorphism is making a comeback in a 'barely-there' form - subtle dimensional depth without the heavy 2010s skeuomorphic excess
The skill's strict complexity budget (4-7 shapes, 3 colors, 32x32 recognizability) is a masterclass in constraint-driven design
The 'never reveal it's a logo' prompt strategy is a clever prompt-engineering insight for avoiding image-model bias toward generic logo templates
One-pass batch generation (no filtering, no auto-retry) treats image generation as a creative draw rather than a quality gate - a philosophical shift
The lower-corner emergence composition (85-95% fill) is a distinctive, brandable visual signature
